allowed_input: Only the immutable 36 resolved Discovery trade records already persisted in BOER_FINAL_RESULT_V01.json plus FROZEN_PROTOCOL_V01.json

tier2_hard_eligibility.B: No leakage hindsight outcome-driven parameter selection or cherry-picking
tier2_hard_eligibility.D: Base mean net expectancy > 0 and profit factor >= 1.00
tier2_hard_eligibility.E: Expected reversal relationship/sign correct in aggregate
tier2_hard_eligibility.F: No fatal execution/risk pathology; if both available, max drawdown >50% AND cumulative net <5% blocks Tier 2
tier2_hard_eligibility.G: Evidence not solely a post-hoc selected asset regime quarter horizon or subgroup

support_path_1.equivalent_primary_statistic: one-sided 90% percentile-bootstrap lower bound of frozen base-net mean
support_path_1.reason_for_method: Direct one-sided equivalent of the original prospectively frozen percentile bootstrap; no alternative test family is selected post-outcome
support_path_1.pass_rule: one_sided_90pct_lower_bound > 0 AND at least 50% of major temporal blocks positive

derived_risk_diagnostics.profit_factor: sum positive base-net returns / absolute sum negative base-net returns
derived_risk_diagnostics.max_drawdown_compounded: maximum peak-to-trough drawdown of sequential compounded equity curve
derived_risk_diagnostics.max_single_trade_share_of_positive_net: largest positive base-net return / total positive base-net returns
derived_risk_diagnostics.minimum_leave_one_trade_out_mean: minimum base-net mean after removing each one trade in turn

classification_rule.tier2: All A-G hard eligibility true AND Path 1 support true
classification_rule.tier3: Clean usable evidence but Tier 2 support fails without Tier 4 rejection evidence
classification_rule.tier4: Only if V2 rejection conditions are actually established
classification_rule.tier1: NOT_ASSESSED; no independent/OOS replication is opened by this adjudication
